exclusions: The broad third-party app-connection and secret-sync administration catalog is intentionally out of contract; retained SQL rotation references, gateway/proxy administration and integration metadata are not excluded.

Unexposed approval administration, access requests, point-in-time recovery, insights and webhook administration have ContractNotEstablished availability; there is no invented callable API or admission row.

Dynamic definition configuration covers all 28 declared profiles; AcquireDatabaseAsync exposes only the six SQL engines. Non-SQL credential acquisition/result shapes have no public acquisition method and remain unestablished, not certified by definition CRUD.
Individual Universal client-secret DELETE and individual Token Auth token DELETE have no public factory; configuration DELETE and credential revoke remain admitted distinct contracts.

Gateway identity authentication is a returned configuration alternative, not a create/update input factory. Unexposed gateway list/delete/revoke, pools/relays and proxy runtime entrypoints are not fabricated here.

Arbitrary vendor SDK methods, raw endpoints, host interfaces, target builders, material disposal and StopAsync are not independently owned remote entrypoints. The synchronous ManagementRequest factories are admitted because ExecuteAsync sends them.

Primitive value domains are bounded by the hashed types. Variant labels enumerate semantic dimensions, not every numeric value or every Cartesian combination; each dimension needs its operation-specific cases under complete-live policy.
